passages.text: Aichryson divaricatum is a species of succulent plant of the family Crassulaceae endemic to Madeira.

Description
It is usually smooth and glabrous, {{convert|4|to|30|cm|in}} tall and green. It has a dark green, ascending stem. Flowers are {{convert|6|-|10|mm|in}} in diagonal, most with 7-petals, in dense summits. Petals are {{convert|3|-|5|mm|in}}, ovate, short aristated, pale golden yellow, with a central dorsal rib.

Distribution
The species is endemic to Madeira Island and Desertas Islands and is commonly found on rocks over levadas, cliffs, walls, ravines and sometimes on tree trunks between {{convert|100|and|1000|m|ft}} in altitude.
